population: SYNTHETIC + DEVELOPMENT -- no holdout opened, nothing scored
anchor_equality: the WHOLE emitted production Anchor value (page, line, kind, text, division); no reduced signature is invented for frames
development_note: DEVELOPMENT figures are diagnostics that exercise the code paths. They are not study results and no metric is scored from them.

tests.test: control 10: a 19-line page yields 3 regions, the last a SHORT TRAILING one
tests.fails_when: a dropped tail would make the last 1-7 neutral lines of every page unsamplable

tests.test: ...and the trailing region is flagged as such
control 2: every neutral line belongs to exactly one region
tests.fails_when: a line in zero regions is unsamplable; a line in two would double-count it

tests.test: control 11: each page starts its own region grid at ordinal 0
tests.fails_when: a continuing ordinal would let a region span two pages

tests.test: control 11b: I5 -- no region contains lines from two pages
a 5-line page still yields one short trailing region
control 4: a page neither arm emitted creates NO D-frame membership
tests.fails_when: counting a shared drop as discordance would flood the D-frame with page furniture

tests.test: ...and its lines are still IN the artifact and the region grid (I3)
...and are excluded from the M0 comparative risk set (I3)
control 6: a text change on ONE arm puts its region in D
tests.fails_when: if this passed without the injection, the text predicate would never fire

tests.test: ...and ONLY the mutated line is recorded as text-discordant (I4)
control 8: concordant lines inside a D region are NOT individually qualifying (I4)
tests.fails_when: marking the whole region's lines discordant would fabricate M0a numerator entries

tests.test: ...and a text-only difference does NOT move the segmentation signature
tests.fails_when: the two quantities are deliberately orthogonal; coupling them would corrupt M3

tests.test: control 5: a merge on ONE arm puts its region in D via SEGMENTATION
tests.fails_when: a merge that did not move the signature would make M0b structurally blind

tests.test: ...and the merge did NOT move the projected text (grouping vs characters)
tests.fails_when: if a merge moved the text, a segmentation difference would fabricate an M3 boundary error

tests.test: control 7: an anchor-set difference alone puts the region in D
tests.fails_when: PRE-REGISTRATION 5.8 makes a differing emitted anchor set region-level evidence

tests.test: ...with no line recorded as text- or segmentation-discordant (I4)
baseline: with no injection the region is NOT in D
tests.fails_when: a baseline that was already in D would make all four injections vacuous

tests.test: control 12: a 61-region D census is emitted in full, not truncated at 60
tests.fails_when: truncating here would destroy the count A27.3 uses to decide whether Rule 1 may run

tests.test: ...and the artifact says so explicitly
the complete region grid is enumerated from the skeleton (I1)
control 3: a body line BOTH arms dropped is still in the grid, in region 0, BOTH_ABSENT
tests.fails_when: enumerating regions from EMITTED lines would make this line unsamplable and the shared failure invisible -- exactly what the C-frame exists to catch

tests.test: ...and its region is C-frame ELIGIBLE, i.e. reachable by the frozen draw
...and the drop did not put its region in the D-frame (I3)
tests.fails_when: a shared drop belongs to RQ2 via the C-frame, never to the comparative D-frame

tests.test: the C-frame draw is capped at 8 regions per document
control 9: the same identities select the same set AND the same order
tests.fails_when: any listing-order dependence would make the sample irreproducible

tests.test: ...and building the document with pages listed in reverse selects the same regions
a selected C region stays selected even when an arm drops all of its content
tests.fails_when: replacing such a region would delete the shared-failure evidence RQ2 exists to collect

tests.test: a P-robust document receives NO C-frame selection
tests.fails_when: the C-frame quantity is defined on P-head only

tests.test: ...but its regions are still enumerated in full
tests.fails_when: if enumeration were skipped too, the D-frame would silently lose the document

tests.test: A19: the arms bridge onto ONE neutral skeleton on every development page
tests.fails_when: differing skeletons would mean the two arms' frames are not the same frame

tests.test: build_frames' anchor placement reproduces x14's, anchor for anchor
tests.fails_when: a divergence would mean the frames use a bridge the study never approved

tests.test: no anchor placement refusal on development material
tests.fails_when: a refusal is recorded, never guessed past -- but any residue needs explaining

tests.test: every development document retained at least one short trailing region
tests.fails_when: a page tail of 1-7 neutral lines must survive as its own region

tests.test: no development document exceeded the 8-region C-frame cap
